assignment.method: Unsigned 256-bit rejection sampling modulo 720 and 20. Assign the six distinct chronological arm permutations uniformly to six distinct boots, with three option-first boots chosen independently. All observed slots remain in their enrolled block.

comparison: Six new, independent boot blocks, three physical role installations per suite. No old C2 or third historical-case measurements are scored. Both independently made #337 source kit member manifests, standard library, executing binaries and actual rustdoc must be byte/mode/size equal. Each role runs at the same canonical path on its boot; each ordinary per-role checkout history starts privately empty.
counter: Entire ordinary rustup/Cargo process plus every descendant and thread, hardware retired user instructions, inherited from exec; outer strace observes real exec only on warm scored calls, no rename or open instrumentation in counters. Keep calibrated child/fork/thread/negative tests, time_enabled==time_running>0 and raw counter. No guest/unit conversion.

inference.effect: Unweighted median per-boot savings 1-C/P, both sides/individual counts and three-way raw rosters. Exact distribution-free per-contrast two-sided matched median bounds use [min,max] (96.875% marginal with six independent continuous boot differences); simultaneous minimum coverage on the two primary medians is 93.75% (Bonferroni). The simultaneous one-sided lower bounds from the minima have at least 96.875% coverage. State the exchangeable/independent boot assumption.
inference.failure: All six distinct boots, all three roles and every registered observable must succeed before formal arithmetic. A failed transfer or comparator is preserved with zero scored inferences. No cherry-picking or replacing a physical acquisition on sight.
inference.joint: For the sharp null that no role changes any observation, condition on chronological outcomes and enumerate all 720 permitted boot-to-permutation assignments. Statistic product over boots of P^2/(C2*C3b). One-sided p counts equality as extreme using exact integer cross-products.
inference.pairwise: For P against each candidate, and C2 against C3b, condition on the third role position in every boot. Swap the two permissible schedules as a pair within each of the three two-boot strata. Evaluate the product of baseline/comparison costs across the eight admissible schedules including ties. Minimum exact pairwise p=1/8. Show signs separately without claiming six unrestricted random sign flips.

native.case_gate: Every source, input, exact native behavior and capsule check from the original two-role native operator is required. In the option forward edit, all thirteen previously accepted genuine C2 CGUs and the independently mapped 92ezh47i978bb5yfl2leg6c1y must physically rename a placed object. 0wrsgo9esbuwdyfhrjd10085r and 6p30kgvj4lu40zowlel28tnn7 must run ordinary LLVM. All 125 complete object bytes including DWARF must equal their own independent source build on forward and return, and all native shims, source check, E0308 and repair must pass. One changed known hit must fall back; a damaged optional index must yield no hits. Any refusal is recorded before scoring.
native.unchanged_operator: Separate new worker per suite. Full native, actual ELF, independent clean, illegal and repair; exact ordinary root rustc, shared owner extern paths, signed Cargo/Wild ABI and required ordinary native links. Root .o published from fresh ohm-placement temp is a positive. Baseline and all truly empty/repeat option have zero. Mutate an actual previously accepted file and optional index tail on distinct private option histories.

For each candidate independently, a 10% engineering gate requires 10*C < 9*P on every new boot and every native prerequisite. Report the 2x threshold independently on all pairs. Six comparisons establish a fresh estimate only. no rescue or pooling of the older 2x screen.

Preserve every entry, logical length, st_blocks*512, nlink, dev/ino, mode, and symlink target, de-duplicate (dev,ino) across both. Account optional bytes inside every work-products.bin separately, no second cache. Retention in evidence downloads is reported separately.
